lineage.semantics: graph mask indexes the source rows; each hex bitfield has bitS for the saved independent vertex subsetS. Copy only row[2], the degree-zero field; no adjacency, induced-degree or regularity re-evaluation.

conventions.graph: all labelled simple graphs on vertices0..5, fifteen supplied edge labels
conventions.copies: distinct spanning K2,2,2 edge sets; optional within-pair edges allowed
